adaptations: Removed unused original dataset/Lightning wrappers; neural networks and diffusion equations are reused.
Exposed x0_clip, daily default 6 instead of upstream implicit 2 for standardized data.
New daily data, pure PyTorch runner, evaluation and server management surround the reused core.
release_changes: Portable code-only package and synthetic smoke/CI; private data and server setup excluded.
Default denoising x0 bounds [6,3] exposed as a nonpersistent registered buffer, preserving old state_dict keys.
Standalone sampling and fidelity CLI; DDPM training with default DDIM20 sampling.
